card.name: Weekday names and digits in citations
card.fires_on: Abbreviated or full weekday names (Tue, Tuesday) before a date, and single digits inside reference numbers such as ISBN, DOI, ISSN, journal volumes and phone numbers.

modes.label: Weekday before a date
modes.description: The word Tue or Tuesday placed just before a month and day in a page header or news dateline.

modes.label: Digit inside reference codes
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of an ISBN, DOI, ISSN, volume number or phone number.

card.writes: It pushes toward relative-path strings like '../' and away from word endings such as 'nd', 'noon' and 'eve'.
card.plain: It fires on Tuesday in dates and on digits in the middle of ISBN, DOI and phone numbers.
